title: Rhythm Kings Victor and OK recording sessions
summary: He describes the two sessions in New Orleans, Rappolo's high notes, and who played.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Who made the records? Do you know?

Yeah. The ones they made here, you mean? Uh, uh... August Schillang on drums. Uh... Santo, Rap. Well now they made... They made two sessions here. They made an OK session here and they made a Victor session here. The OK was with Santo, Rap, Paul... Steve Loiskaner, Freddie Newman, piano, and Chink. And a tenor? Lester. Lester Bouchon. Yeah. And the drums? August Schillang. Yeah. The Victor date, it started out with the same band, but Rap, Old Man King was the recording you used. You ought to know about him though. You know about him? I don't remember. Oh, he was the son of a gun. Man, he was one of the sticklers for being in tune and that, you know. The Victor. I seen him in California. We were making a date the same time as Ellington was making a date in California. I seen him keep Ellington from 8 o'clock in the morning until 6 o'clock at night without making a side. Because he couldn't get the band in tune. He thought. So what happened at this date with the Rhythm Kings is they didn't have... They didn't have Freddie Newman. They had Red Long on the piano. And they had Rap and Charlie Cadilla. No, Charlie wasn't there at the beginning. So they were playing and every time Rap would get a chorus, he'd get up and hit one of those P-Wistle notes, you know. And he'd blow the... That was before the electric. They had blow the needle off the wax, you see. And Old Man King kept telling him to quit playing those high notes, you see. And to tell Rap to quit doing anything, well, you just might as well talk to the King of England, you know. Who does he think he is? You know, so they finally wound up, they run Rap out of the studio. That's just before we went to the Bug House. So they run Rap out of the studio and they got a cent for Charlie Cadilla. So it wound up Charlie Cadilla made the date. On the Victor. That date.
The others were all the same? They only made... I mean the others were all the same, the drummer and all. Yeah. No, no, no, with the...

On the Victor date. No, with the Victor date, Leo. Leo Eddie. Right. Because they made that right after they come back from Mobile. They made the Victor date first and then they made the OK. That's the one with the Golden Leaf Strut and Crying For Me. They made on that.
